english.title: Distributor fail to keep regulation 45 records for four years and make them available to Secretary of State

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a distributor, failed to keep records referred to in regulation 45 of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 for a period of at least four years commencing on the date on which the record was made and make them available to the Secretary of State on demand
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 45(4), 90(6) and 91(2) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
